# outputs/enso/seasonal/ — Seasonal dependence

## Purpose

Season × phase contingency tables and tests.

## Typical contents

CSV tables (often under `csv/` or at folder root) and PNG/PDF figures (often under `figures/`). Per-region files named with `north` / `central` / `south`; many stages include a `summary.csv`.

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/enso_seasonal_analysis.py`

## Upstream / Downstream

Reads MHW catalogues + ENSO index timeseries; feeds `outputs/climate_comparison/` and `outputs/master_event_catalogue/`.

## Notes

Part of the comparable six-stage design shared by ENSO, IOD, and MEI. See parent `outputs/enso/README.md`.
